convert_stable_diffusion_checkpoint: convert an original stable diffusion checkpoint to diffusers pipeline format and save to disk
convert_checkpoint_with_ema_weights: convert a stable diffusion checkpoint extracting EMA weights for higher quality inference images
convert_checkpoint_to_safetensors: convert a stable diffusion checkpoint and save the pipeline in safetensors format
convert_controlnet_checkpoint: convert a controlnet checkpoint to diffusers format and save only the controlnet model
convert_checkpoint_half_precision: convert a stable diffusion checkpoint and save weights in half precision float16 format
